item.title: Securing the Future of Scotland’s libraries – SLIC’s new vision statement
item.description: In its new vision statement, titled Securing the Future of Scotland’s Libraries, the Scottish Library and Information Council (SLIC) has called for “urgent sustained development” to help safeguard Scotland’s libraries. item.description: Through Publishing Scotland’s ‘Go-See’ initiative, BookSource is pleased to offer support to the Scotland based publishing community to help develop their businesses, to reach new markets, and to internationalise their offering. item.title: Winners of Scotland’s National Book Awards 2025
item.description: Last night in Edinburgh was the ceremony for the Saltires, Scotland's National Book Awards. Prizes were awarded for the winners of Scotland’s Fiction, Non-Fiction, Poetry and Research Books of the Year 2025, and the winners of Scotland’s Fiction, Non-Fiction and Poetry Debuts of the Year 2025. The post Winners of Scotland’s National Book Awards 2025 appeared first on Publishing Scotland.
